svg.text: EnergyHub — Battery Reserve, Not a Charging Target
One applied reserve floor; separate night and scheduled-outage targets can temporarily require more
1 · FAMILY SETTINGS
Configured minimum and Manual/Automatic authority
Manual keeps the selected applied reserve
Automatic uses the guarded HA application path
Recommendation is not proof it was applied
2 · USABLE TODAY SCHEDULE
Confirmed current-day schedule, including empty day
BR = configured minimum + 20 scheduled points
Add qualifying weather and emergency allowances
Do not add Grid Confidence again in this branch
3 · NO USABLE TODAY SCHEDULE
BR = configured minimum + Grid Confidence
Confidence allowance: 0 / 20 / 40 / 60 points
Add qualifying weather and emergency allowances
Unknown source is not proof of no restrictions
4 · COMMON ALLOWANCES
Qualifying official weather warning: +20 points
Active emergency/suspension allowance: +20
All applicable terms once; result capped at 95%
No forecast-deficit or Smart Heating +20 term
5 · ORDINARY INVERTER SUPPORT
Fresh grid available + SOC below applied floor: charge
At the floor: grid hold preserves reserve
Ordinary Solar release uses reserve +10 points
At 95% cap: hold until reserve decreases
6 · OTHER OWNERS STAY SEPARATE
Night target adds an energy-based forecast deficit
Scheduled preparation sizes an outage target
Manual Panic owns its explicit conservative target
Plug/HP SOC protection is not a BR allowance
Grid Confidence is historical reliability, not instantaneous mains availability. Missing evidence must remain qualified.
